Class Player

java.lang.Object
app.model.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Player>
public class Player extends Object implements Comparable<Player>
Represents a player in a card game. This class maintains the details of a player's game attributes such as score, status, hand of cards, and other player-specific properties. It also supports observer notification for changes in the player's state. Implements the Comparable interface to enable comparison based on score.

    • getMostShape

      public int getMostShape()
      Determines the suit (shape) with the highest occurrence in the player's hand. If there is a tie, or in 20% of the cases (simulated randomly), the method randomly selects a suit.
      Returns:
      an integer representing the suit with the highest occurrence: 0 for spades, 1 for hearts, 2 for diamonds, 3 for clubs.

      public void resetHand()

    • callNotify

      public void callNotify()
      Notifies all registered observers about changes in the player's state. This method serves as a convenience wrapper around the notifyObservers method to ensure that any updates to the player's state are communicated to the observers promptly. The specific behavior of the notification depends on the observer type: - If the observer is an instance of PlayerStatusView, it receives updates with the current player state and the handleCard status. - If the observer is an instance of PlayerHandView and the player is the current player (as determined by isSelf()), it receives updates with the player's state and a default value for handleCard. - Other observers receive updates with the player's state and default values. The handleCard flag is reset to false after the notification.

    • addObserver

      public void addObserver(PlayerObserver observer)
      Registers an observer to monitor changes in the player's state or actions. The observer will be notified whenever relevant updates occur.
      Parameters:
      observer - the PlayerObserver instance to be registered

    • notifyObservers

      public void notifyObservers()
      Notifies all registered observers about changes to the player's state. The method iterates over all observers subscribed to the current player and invokes their update method with specific parameters based on their type: - If the observer is an instance of PlayerStatusView, it receives a call to the update method with this player object and the current state of handleCard. - If the observer is an instance of PlayerHandView and the player is identified as "self", the observer's update method is invoked with this player object and false. - All other observers are also notified using this player object and false. After notifying all observers, the internal handleCard flag is reset to false.
